questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct representation of the set of all natural numbers less than 100?
questions.solution: The correct representation is {1, 2, 3, ..., 99} because the set of natural numbers starts from 1 and includes all numbers less than 100. The option {1, 2, 3, ..., 100} includes 100, which is not less than 100. The option {0, 1, 2, ..., 99} includes 0, which is not a natural number. The option {0, 1, 2, ..., 100} includes both 0 and 100, which are not natural numbers.

questions.stem: What does it mean for two sets to be equal?
choices: They have the same number of elements
They have exactly the same elements
They are both subsets of each other
questions.solution: Two sets are equal if they contain exactly the same elements. The option They have exactly the same elements is correct. The option They have the same number of elements is incorrect because two sets can have the same number of elements but different elements. The option They are both subsets of each other is incorrect because it describes a subset relationship, not equality. The option They are both finite sets is incorrect because it describes a property of the set, not equality.

hi.solution: दो सेट ठीक एक ही तत्व रखते हैं तो वे बराबर होते हैं। विकल्प ठीक एक ही तत्व होते हैं सही है। विकल्प उनके तत्वों की संख्या समान होती है गलत है क्योंकि दो सेट एक ही संख्या के तत्व रख सकते हैं लेकिन अलग-अलग तत्व हो सकते हैं। विकल्प वे एक दूसरे के उपसेट होते हैं गलत है क्योंकि यह उपसेट संबंध का वर्णन करता है, न कि समानता। विकल्प वे दोनों परिमित सेट होते हैं गलत है क्योंकि यह सेट के गुण का वर्णन करता है, न कि समानता।

questions.solution: The intersection of A, B, and C contains elements common to all three sets. The only element common to all three is 3. Therefore, A ∩ B ∩ C = {3}. The option {3} is correct. The option {2, 3} is incorrect because 2 is not in C. The option {3, 4} is incorrect because 4 is not in A. The option {4, 5} is incorrect because neither 4 nor 5 is in A.

hi.solution: A, B और C के प्रतिच्छेद में तीनों सेटों के सामान्य अवयव होते हैं। तीनों सेटों में केवल एक अवयव 3 सामान्य है। अतः A ∩ B ∩ C = {3}। विकल्प {3} सही है। विकल्प {2, 3} गलत है क्योंकि 2, C में नहीं है। विकल्प {3, 4} गलत है क्योंकि 4, A में नहीं है। विकल्प {4, 5} गलत है क्योंकि 4 या 5 में से कोई भी A में नहीं है।

questions.stem: Which of the following sets is a finite set?
choices: {x : x is a letter in the word MATHEMATICS}
{x : x is a point on a line}
questions.solution: The set {x : x is a letter in the word MATHEMATICS} is finite because the word MATHEMATICS has a finite number of distinct letters. The set {x : x is a natural number} is infinite because there are infinitely many natural numbers. The set {x : x is a point on a line} is infinite because there are infinitely many points on a line. The set {x : x is an even integer} is infinite because there are infinitely many even integers.
